# Perform rating updates/creates for songs in album library that are liked
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pw = [c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
login_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='jes.mill@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
access_token = login_resp['access_token']
print('access_token_obtained', bool(access_token))

# Actions determined earlier
updates = [(1, 291, 1), (25, 293, 1), (52, 292, 1)]  # (song_id, review_id, old_rating)
creates = [5, 6, 7, 16, 17, 18, 23, 26, 27, 49, 53, 63, 66, 76, 80, 81, 82]

# Update existing lower ratings to 4
update_results=[]
for song_id, review_id, old_rating in updates:
    resp = apis.spotify.update_song_review(review_id=review_id, access_token=access_token, rating=4)
    update_results.append((song_id, review_id, old_rating, resp))
    print('updated', song_id, 'review_id', review_id, 'old', old_rating, '->', 4, 'resp', resp)

# Create reviews with rating 4 for songs without any review
create_results=[]
for song_id in creates:
    resp = apis.spotify.review_song(song_id=song_id, rating=4, access_token=access_token, title='', text='')
    create_results.append((song_id, resp))
    print('created_review_for', song_id, 'resp', resp)

print('update_count', len(update_results), 'create_count', len(create_results))
